findings.description: The Lambda configuration embeds an AWS access key ID and secret access key directly in environment variables. These values are stored in Terraform source/state and can be retrieved by principals able to read the function configuration, exposing long-lived credentials.
The function uses the nodejs12.x runtime, which is deprecated and no longer receives security patches. Known runtime vulnerabilities may remain exploitable in the deployed function.
